title: Comparing Fractions on the Number Line
objective: Compare fractions and whole numbers on the number line by reasoning about distance from 0.

problems.text: Place the two fractions on the number line. Circle the fraction with the distance closest to 0. Then, compare using >, <, or =.

JoAnn and Lupe live straight down the street from their school. JoAnn walks 5/6 miles and Lupe walks 7/8 miles home from school every day. Draw a number line to model how far each girl walks. Who walks the shorter distance?
